cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Only six people cracked our supper-club invitation. Excellent: a more selective table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wonderful. We've filtered out everyone who wasn't committed to dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.

beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.

mechanism: A authorizes increasingly exclusive interpretations of a failed invitation and directs the last unintended attendee's role.
confusable: Unlike accepting low attendance pragmatically, A celebrates each loss as a more selective successful scheme.
comparison: A printer seeking payment becomes a private partner guest, unlike concealment through an unwitting helper.
seedUse: Use puzzle invitation, cancellations and printer from the seed; make S01 control approved guest classification and seating.
